tax.profit.ivao_rate.note: IVAO: tax on operational revenue for eligible SMEs, in place of profit tax.

tax.dividend.rate.note: The 2027 bill (approved by Government 8 September 2026, not adopted) keeps 6% in art. 90^1 alin. (3^1) lit. a) for profits generated before 2027 and sets 8% for profits generated from 2027. A profit-vintage rule, not a payment-date rule.

tax.vat.registration_threshold.note: Art. 112 alin. (1) and (4): raised from MDL 1,200,000 to MDL 1,500,000 from 1 January 2026 by Law 318/2025, and again to MDL 1,700,000 from 1 March 2026 (md-2026.2). Measured over the last 12 consecutive months, not a calendar year, so an entity can cross it at any point; that wording of art. 112 is not read yet.

tax.vat.deduction_requires_electronic_in.note: Art. 102 para (18), which restricted the right to deduct VAT on a non-electronic invoice issued by a supplier on the mandatory e-Factura list, is ABROGATED from 1 January 2026. So from 2026 a paper invoice from a list-obligated supplier no longer costs the buyer its deduction. This materially reduces the commercial pressure to adopt e-Factura and must not be modelled as a blocking validation.

tax.vat.refund_ceiling_efactura_or_mev.note: Not in the Fiscal Code: the Regulation approved by HG 93/2013, pct. 47^3 subpct. 1), caps the refund under art. 101^6 at a share of the VAT that buyers paid, documented through SIA e-Factura and through cash registers connected to MEV. HG 496/2025 raised that share from 20% to 70%, in force on publication, 14 August 2025, so it was already 70% before 2026.

efactura.obligation.basis.text: art. 117 para (1^1) risk-based list; art. 117 para (14) since 2025-01-01
efactura.obligation.basis.note: There is NO universal B2B mandate in force. Obligation arises in these cases: B2G and public procurement (art. 117 alin. (12), restated by Law 187/2025 from 18 July 2025); supplies to economic agents on Moldovan territory without fiscal relations with its budget system (art. 117 alin. (14), Law 214/2024, since 1 January 2025); supplies for the projects of art. 104 lit. c^1) (art. 117 alin. (15)); and inclusion on the SFS risk-based list (art. 117 alin. (1^1), Order SFS 645/2018), changed by SFS Orders 141/2026 and 494/2026. The list size, reported at 69 entities, is from secondary sources.

efactura.mandatory_list.selection_min_cr.note: An entity is added when SFS finds it meets at least three criteria at once („întrunesc concomitent cel puțin trei criterii”). Order SFS 645/2018 lists criteria a) to h); an SFS order of 8 June 2022 reportedly added i) and j), making ten, found only in secondary sources.

efactura.mandatory_list.significant_supp.note: Criterion a) of Order SFS 645/2018: supplies of at least 500 thousand lei a month without material or human assets (fewer than 2 employees), over the last 3 months.

payroll.income_tax.personal_deduction_an.note: Scutirea personală (art. 33 alin. (1)): 29,700 since 1 January 2025, when Law 214/2024 replaced 27,000; unchanged for 2026. Granted monthly as one twelfth from the month after the employee asks for it (HG 697/2014 pct. 18), at one place of work of the employee's choosing: the main job, a second job, where services are provided, or dual education (pct. 9-10), and never at two.

payroll.income_tax.personal_deduction_in.note: Art. 33 alin. (1): the exemption belongs to a resident whose annual taxable income is under 360,000, art. 90^1 income excepted; from 2026 art. 33 alin. (1^1) counts chapter 10^2 and 10^3 income too. The test is the year's taxable income from every source, not one employer's salary. Art. 88 alin. (1), completed by Law 214/2024: 'Angajatorul nu are obligația să urmărească pierderea dreptului de utilizare a scutirii personale.' Whoever used it and earned more files the annual return (art. 83 alin. (2) lit. a^2)). The product today withdraws the whole year's exemption, cumulatively, from the month salary paid here passes the cap; the act does not ask for that. To be decided by the compliance owner. Dependant exemptions (art. 35) are not lost with it.

payroll.cnas.employer_rate.note: Law 489/1999 annex 1 pct. 1.1, as restated by Law 60/2020 from 1 January 2021: 24% of the salaries and rewards computed each month, for private-sector employers and higher-education and medical institutions ('învățământ superior', not all public education). Budget and public-authority employers pay 29%, not encoded. Law 320/2025, the 2026 social insurance budget, carries no rate.

payroll.cnas.employee_rate.note: Law 60/2020 abrogated art. 21 of Law 489/1999, the individual contribution, from 1 January 2021, so contributions are paid entirely by the employer. The 6% figure that circulates in secondary sources applies only to specific categories (daily remuneration for certain workers) and must be modelled as a category-specific exception, not a general rate.

payroll.cnam.employee_rate.note: Prima de asigurare obligatorie de asistență medicală as a percentage of salary, withheld from the employee: 9.0% for 2026 under Law 321/2025 art. 4 alin. (1); Law 212/2026 amended that law without changing it. Deducted from the employee's income before income tax (payroll.income_tax.medical_premium_deductible). No minimum base found.

itpark.single_tax.rate.note: Art. 370 alin. (1): 7% of sales revenue, not less than the minimum per employee. Replaces profit tax, payroll income tax, CNAS and CNAM; VAT applies separately. SFS's Q&A 37.5 (Order SFS 119/2024) still counts local taxes, property tax and road tax among the taxes it replaces (art. 372 alin. (1)); the earlier note that they are paid separately from 2026 was found only in a 2023 draft.

itpark.single_tax.min_per_employee_month.note: Art. 370 alin. (2), per SFS's Q&A 37.3: 30% of the forecast average monthly wage, per employee: 30% of 17,400 is 5,220. Recomputed annually.

filing.tva12.due_day_of_month.note: Art. 115 alin. (1), as quoted by SFS: no later than the 25th of the month after the tax period. That it shifts to the next working day when the 25th is a weekend or holiday is not read yet.

filing.iu17.due_day_of_month.note: Art. 373, as quoted by SFS: by the 25th of the month after the month of management.

filing.ven12.due_date.note: Art. 83 alin. (2) lit. c), as quoted by SFS: by the 25th of the third month after the end of the fiscal period, so 25 March when the fiscal year is the calendar year.

document.factura_fiscala.form_order.note: Strict-regime standardised form with state-issued series and number. From 1 January 2026 OMF 135/2025 adds the mention „Taxare inversă” for supplies under art. 101^7; OMF 47/2026 makes signatures optional on utility invoices.

register.general_invoice_register.in_for.note: Art. 118^1 of the Fiscal Code, which required invoices above MDL 100,000 to be registered in the Registrul general electronic al facturilor fiscale, was abrogated from 1 January 2020 by Law 171/2019. Do not implement it.

tax.vat.reduced_rate.note: Art. 96 lit. b). Read in the amending acts: accommodation, and food and non-alcoholic drinks served under section I of the classifier (HoReCa), at 8% since 10 August 2023 (Law 212/2023 replaced 12%), so no 12% rate applies in 2026; natural gas and liquefied gas at 2711 with their transport and distribution (Law 139/2025, from 2026); medical devices in the State Register (Law 187/2025, from 2026). From secondary sources only: bread and bakery products, milk and dairy products at the listed positions, medicines at 3001-3004, agricultural produce in natural form. The 2027 bill would bring HoReCa back to 12%.

tax.vat.zero_rate.note: Art. 104: supplies taxed at zero with the right to deduct input VAT (exports, among others); Law 139/2025 added lit. b^1), imports of gas and electricity through networks, from 2026. Distinct from exempt supplies under art. 103, which carry no VAT and no right to deduct; the product names those as exempt rather than as a rate. The general text of art. 104 was not read.

tax.vat.line_rounding.note: VAT is computed per invoice line and rounded to two decimals (tax.vat.line_rounding_decimals). Half away from zero is ordinary commercial rounding; konta-efactura currently rounds half to even. The two must agree with what SIA e-Factura computes, to be confirmed on the first round trip with a test account.

tax.vat.line_rounding_decimals.note: Lei and bani: amounts on an invoice have two decimals.

ledger.sales.receivable_account.note: Chapter III: account 221 Creanțe comerciale is debited for goods and services sold, in correspondence with 611 and 534. A company may post to its subaccounts instead.

ledger.sales.revenue_account.note: Chapter III: account 611 Venituri din vînzări is credited for sales. The default for an invoice line; a line may name another revenue account or subaccount.

ledger.sales.vat_account.note: Chapter III: account 534 Datorii față de buget is credited for VAT charged on sales (subaccount 5344 in the act).

ledger.purchases.payable_account.note: Chapter III: 521 Datorii comerciale curente is credited in correspondence with 211, 213, 713 and others as goods and services are received, and debited in correspondence with 242 and others as they are paid. A company may post to its subaccounts instead.

ledger.purchases.vat_account.note: Chapter III prescribes neither choice. 521's credit lists no 534 and no 225; 534 is debited in correspondence with 225 among others, and 225 is debited against 534, so holding deductible VAT on 2252 Creanțe privind TVA and offsetting it against 5344 is the act's own path. Debiting 534 (5344) directly, as the product does, is common Moldovan practice. To be decided by the compliance owner. VAT that cannot be deducted is not posted here but added to the cost of what was bought.

ledger.payments.bank_account.note: Chapter III: account 242 Conturi curente în monedă națională is debited for money received into a current account in correspondence with 221 among others, and credited for money paid out in correspondence with 521 among others. The default for a bank payment in the company's currency; a payment may name a subaccount (2421) or another account the company keeps its money on.

payroll.income_tax.dependant_deduction_a.note: Art. 35 alin. (1): 9,900 a year per dependant since 2025 (Law 214/2024 replaced 9,000), unchanged for 2026. The higher amount is payroll.income_tax.dependant_deduction_disability_annual; a person with income above payroll.income_tax.dependant_income_ceiling_annual is not a dependant.

payroll.income_tax.withholding_method.note: HG 697/2014 pct. 38, as restated by HG 1029/2023: taxable income and the tax are computed cumulatively from the start of the fiscal year, or from the date of hiring. The fișa personală floors the year's taxable income at zero (column 7.8), but the month's tax is the difference between the last two cumulative figures (column 7.10, 'reținerii (rambursării)'), so a month can give back tax withheld earlier. The product never refunds through payroll today: to be decided by the compliance owner. Exemptions accumulate for every month the person counts as employed, whether or not salary was paid (column 7.5).

payroll.income_tax.medical_premium_deduc.note: Codul fiscal art. 35^2 alin. (1), added by Law 212/2023 from 1 January 2024: 'Se permite deducerea, în cuantumurile stabilite de legislație, a sumelor pentru primele de asigurare obligatorie de asistență medicală achitate de persoanele fizice'. HG 697/2014's fișa personală deducts it in column 7.7. SFS's worked example: gross 10,000; premium 900; exemption 2,475; taxable 6,625; tax 795.

payroll.rounding.note: No rounding rule was found in the acts read: HG 1029/2023 rewrote the fișa personală's instructions, and the whole-lei rule that secondary sources describe is not in the new text. Bani throughout, half away from zero, is our choice. To be confirmed by the compliance owner.

payroll.minimum_wage.monthly.note: Salariul minim pe țară from 1 January 2026, for a full programme of 169 hours a month on average (37.28 lei an hour). Up from 5,500.

payroll.average_wage.forecast_monthly.note: Salariul mediu lunar pe economie prognozat pentru 2026, approved by the Government on 17 December 2025 (up from 16,100). Used as a ceiling in several tax rules, none of them built yet.

ledger.payroll.salaries_payable_account.note: Chapter III: 531 Datorii față de personal privind retribuirea muncii is credited for salaries in correspondence with 712, 713, 714, 811 and others, and debited in correspondence with 533 and 534 for what is withheld and with 242 for what is paid out. Subaccount 5311 Datorii salariale.

ledger.payroll.social_insurance_account.note: Chapter III: 533 is credited for contributions in correspondence with the expense accounts. Subaccount 5331 Datorii față de bugetul asigurărilor sociale de stat, for the employer's CNAS contribution.

ledger.payroll.medical_insurance_account.note: Chapter III: 533 is credited in correspondence with 531 for the premium withheld. Subaccount 5332 Datorii față de fondurile asigurării obligatorii de asistență medicală.

ledger.payroll.income_tax_account.note: Chapter III: 534 is credited in correspondence with 531 for tax withheld. Subaccount 5342 Datorii privind impozitul pe venit din salariu.

ledger.payroll.expense_account.note: The default expense for a salary and its CNAS contribution, administrative (713). Chapter III lets 531 correspond with 712, 713, 714, 811, 812 and others; which one is the employee's function, so each employee may name their own. The default is a convenience, not a rule of the act.

payroll.income_tax.major_personal_deduct.note: Scutirea personală majoră (art. 33 alin. (2)), for the categories that paragraph lists, in place of the ordinary one: 34,620 since 2025 (Law 214/2024 replaced 31,500). Not used by the product yet.

payroll.income_tax.spouse_deduction_annu.note: Art. 34 alin. (2), the spouse's exemption in the case that paragraph covers: 21,780 since 2025 (Law 214/2024 replaced 19,800). Which case it is has to be read in the consolidated text. Not used by the product yet.

payroll.income_tax.dependant_deduction_d.note: Art. 35 alin. (1), the higher amount per dependant: 21,780 since 2025 (Law 214/2024 replaced 19,800). That it covers severe or accentuated, congenital or childhood disability comes from secondary sources. Not used by the product yet.

payroll.income_tax.dependant_income_ceil.note: Art. 35 alin. (2) lit. b): a person whose own annual income is above this is not a dependant. 12,400 since 2025 (Law 214/2024 replaced 11,280). Not used by the product yet.

tax.profit.ivao_revenue_ceiling.note: Art. 54^1 alin. (3) lit. a) and (3^1): 1.2 million became 1.5 million from 1 January 2026 (Law 318/2025). Read as the IVAO regime's revenue ceiling from the amending text; the consolidated wording is not read. Law 12/2026 moved the VAT threshold to 1.7 million from March but this figure stayed: to be confirmed by the compliance owner.
